appliedUpdates.description: Updated architecture.md FrameDecoder invariant to include max_buffer_size (default 512) with overflow protection

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note: CaptureLogger pattern (thread_local + RefCell<Vec<String>> + std::sync::Once for log::set_logger) is used in launa-protocol dispatcher tests for verifying log output. Workers writing tests for log::warn! calls should reuse this pattern.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: protocol-dispatcher-warn-logging feature introduced CaptureLogger in dispatcher.rs lines 535-585. Other crates with log::warn! in library code may need the same pattern for testing.

rejectedObservations.observation: rust-worker skill doesn't account for deletion-only features where TDD doesn't apply
rejectedObservations.reason: Edge case; the worker handled it correctly with followedProcedure=true. Not worth a skill change for one rare scenario.

rejectedObservations.observation: Protocol documentation gap: bits 2-5 of config byte 6 are undocumented
rejectedObservations.reason: This is a documentation improvement, not a codebase convention or operational concern. Should be tracked in TASKS.md or docs/ if needed, not in factory library.

rejectedObservations.observation: FrameDecoder overflow check fires on every byte push (minor perf concern on ESP32)
rejectedObservations.reason: Already noted as non_blocking by reviewer. Simple usize comparison is negligible even on ESP32. Not actionable.
